name: Milw0rm
description: Milw0rm was a hacktivist group best known for penetrating India's Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) on June 3, 1998 — at the time the largest mass hack ever recorded. The group inserted anti-nuclear weapons messages and peace statements across hacked websites in protest of India's nuclear weapons tests. Their slogan was 'Putting the power back in the hands of the people.'
